item.title: Qatar condemns repeated Iranian attacks on Kuwait in strongest terms
item.description:
Qatar's Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Thursday condemned the renewed Iranian attacks on Kuwait, most recently drone strikes on vital sites that caused deaths and injuries. The ministry called the attacks a blatant violation of Kuwait's sovereignty and territorial integrity, warned that their continuation risks escalating tensions, and called for dialogue and diplomatic solutions, affirming Qatar's full solidarity with Kuwait.
Sources: The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/26/11/2026/qatar-strongly-condemns-repeated-iranian-attacks-on-kuwait-1 · Qatar Tribune (QNA) https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266638/latest-news/qatar-strongly-condemns-repeated-iranian-attacks-on-kuwait · Arab News https://www.arabnews.com/saudi-arabia/kingdom-leads-arab-condemnation-of-deadly-drone-attack-on-kuwait-3014178

item.title: The Amir leaves Cairo, seen off by El-Sisi at the airport
item.description:
HH the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani left Cairo on Thursday evening at the end of an official visit to Egypt, seen off by President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi at Cairo International Airport. The talks at Al Ittihadiya Palace covered stronger partnership in trade, investment and energy, consolidating the Gaza ceasefire and regional de-escalation.
Sources: The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/26/11/2026/amir-leaves-cairo-2 · Daily News Egypt https://dailynewsegypt.com/2026/11/26/egypt-and-qatar-call-for-regional-de-escalation-stronger-economic-and-energy-ties-during-emirs-cairo-visit/ · MENAFN (QNA) https://menafn.com/1112027373/Amir-President-Of-Egypt-Hold-Official-Talks-Session

item.title: Araghchi says Qatari and Pakistani mediators relay messages between Tehran and Washington
item.description:
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said on Thursday that Qatari and Pakistani mediators continue to relay ideas and proposals between Iran and the United States. He said ideas had been put forward and paths could open, but Tehran's main position was unchanged and reopening the Strait of Hormuz depends on meeting its demands, including lifting the naval blockade and sanctions and releasing frozen assets.
Sources: BOE Report (Reuters) https://boereport.com/2026/11/26/mediators-continue-transmitting-messages-between-iran-and-us-irans-foreign-minister-says/ · A News (Anadolu) https://www.anews.com.tr/middle-east/2026/11/26/iran-says-qatari-pakistani-mediation-in-talks-with-us-continues

item.title: Lusail hosts the Formula 1 Qatar Grand Prix from Friday
item.description:
Free practice for the Qatar Grand Prix, round 22 of the Formula 1 world championship, starts at Lusail International Circuit on Friday 27 November, with qualifying on Saturday and the 57-lap race on Sunday at 7pm local time. Kimi Antonelli and Mercedes have already secured both titles, while Verstappen, Hamilton, Russell and Norris contest second place.
Sources: Formula 1 https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/need-to-know-the-most-important-facts-stats-and-trivia-ahead-of-the-2026-qatar-grand-prix.7Ayey9W9IVQ1yNkR8F6zEI · Motorsport.com https://www.motorsport.com/f1/news/f1-qatar-gp-2026-start-time-schedule-how-to-watch/10877085/

item.title: Doha Women Forum holds its ninth edition on Saturday under the theme Reframe
item.description:
The Doha Women Forum holds its ninth edition on Saturday 28 November at the Grand Hyatt Doha from 2pm to 6pm, under the theme Reframe: The Human Perspective. More than 300 women and speakers from Qatar and abroad are taking part in the forum, which has run since 2015.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/26/11/2026/doha-women-forum-returns-for-its-9th-edition-exploring-different-perspectives · Marhaba Qatar https://marhaba.qa/event/doha-women-forum-2026/

item.title: Two Italian technicians killed in drone attack on vital site in Kuwait
item.description:
Kuwait's Defence Ministry said on Thursday that two Italian technicians died of injuries from debris of drones intercepted over a vital facility, after reporting four wounded, including a Kuwaiti and a Pakistani, in the morning. Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said the two worked for Rheinmetall's Italian unit at an air-defence surveillance station. Tehran denied conducting any military operation in the area.
Sources: Internazionale (Reuters) https://www.internazionale.it/ultime-notizie-reuters/2026/11/26/two-italians-killed-in-iranian-drone-attack-in-kuwait-italy-says · Arab News https://www.arabnews.com/saudi-arabia/kingdom-leads-arab-condemnation-of-deadly-drone-attack-on-kuwait-3014178 · The New Arab https://www.newarab.com/news/iran-denies-deadly-kuwait-attack-houthis-target-saudi-refinery · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-9-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-tonight-november-26-1.500762280

item.title: Houthi strike on Jazan refinery kills Nepali worker and halts some operations
item.description:
Saudi Arabia's Energy Ministry said on Thursday that a hostile aerial projectile hit the Jazan refinery on the Red Sea, sparking a fire that halted some operations, killed a Nepali worker and injured others. The Coalition to Restore Legitimacy said it destroyed a ballistic missile launch platform in Hodeidah used in the attack and warned of a firm military response. The refinery can process 400,000 barrels a day.
Sources: Arab News https://www.arabnews.com/saudi-arabia/houthi-attack-on-saudi-arabias-jazan-refinery-kills-nepali-worker-3014153 · Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/mena/us-israel-iran-saudi-arabia-yemen-war-live-updates-november-26-2026 · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-9-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-tonight-november-26-1.500762280

item.title: Saudi Arabia and the GCC hold Iran responsible for the Kuwait attack
item.description:
Saudi Arabia's Foreign Ministry on Thursday condemned the strike on a vital facility in Kuwait and held Tehran responsible, warning that continued Iranian attacks deepen tension and instability. GCC Secretary-General Jasem Al-Budaiwi called it a dangerous escalation, and the UAE, Bahrain and Jordan condemned it, with Bahrain urging the UN Security Council to ensure Iran complies with Resolution 2817.
Sources: Arab News https://www.arabnews.com/saudi-arabia/kingdom-leads-arab-condemnation-of-deadly-drone-attack-on-kuwait-3014178 · UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs https://www.mofa.gov.ae/en/MediaHub/News/2026/11/26/uae-Kuwait

item.title: ADNOC L&S confirms Jordanian sailor found dead after Hormuz attack
item.description:
ADNOC Logistics & Services confirmed on Thursday that a Jordanian crew member missing since the 17 November attack on one of its vessels in the Strait of Hormuz has been found dead. Eleven sailors were injured in the attack; nine have been discharged and two remain in care. The company urged the public to rely on official sources.
Sources: Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/uae-adnoc-confirms-missing-crew-member-dead-strait-of-hormuz-vessel-attack · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/middle-east-war-9-things-uae-residents-need-to-know-tonight-november-26-1.500762280

item.title: Revolutionary Guards say two tankers exploded on sea mines north of Khasab
item.description:
Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on Thursday that two tankers exploded and caught fire after hitting sea mines north of Oman's Khasab port while crossing the Strait of Hormuz by an unauthorised route, one of them a supertanker carrying over 2 million barrels. No owner or flag state has confirmed the claim, while UKMTO reported a projectile exploding near a tanker 50 nautical miles west of Dubai.
Sources: Baird Maritime (Reuters) https://www.bairdmaritime.com/security/incidents/acts-of-war/iran-says-two-tankers-exploded-after-hitting-sea-mines-near-oman · OilPrice.com https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Iran-Says-LNG-Carrier-Exploded-After-Hitting-a-Mine-in-Hormuz.html · Unbiased Headlines https://unbiasedheadlines.com/article/iran-claims-lng-carrier-hit-a-mine-in-hormuz-and-ukmto-reports-a-separate-tanker

item.title: Makkah pact states meet in Islamabad with Yemen on the agenda
item.description:
Islamabad hosts a meeting of Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkey on Friday and Saturday on the joint defence pact signed in Mecca in August, attended by the Saudi and Turkish foreign ministers. Pakistani Defence Minister Khawaja Asif said continuous turmoil south of Saudi Arabia would be on the agenda, and that any threat to Saudi Arabia is a threat to Pakistan and Turkey under the pact.
Sources: Al-Monitor (Reuters) https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/pakistan-saudi-turkey-hold-mecca-alliance-meeting-islamabad-nov-27-28-sources-say · Arab News Pakistan (AFP) https://www.arabnews.pk/pakistan/pakistan-defense-minister-says-makkah-pact-nations-to-discuss-yemen-in-islamabad-3008170

item.title: Donations for Warraq Ring Road victims exceed EGP200 million in seven hours
item.description:
Cabinet spokesman Mohamed Adel said on Thursday evening that contributions announced for the families of those killed and injured in the Warraq Ring Road accident exceeded EGP200 million within about seven hours of the Prime Minister's appeal. They include EGP60 million from the banking sector, EGP30 million from civil aviation and about EGP24 million from civil associations, with the Social Solidarity Ministry disbursing funds through a Nasser Social Bank account.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536527 · Amwal Al Ghad https://amwalalghad.com/2026/11/26/%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-200-%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%AC%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%87-%D8%AA%D8%A8%D8%B1%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%B6%D8%B1/ · Al-Dawla News https://www.aldawlanews.com/1392791

item.title: Central bank directs banks to give EGP60 million initial support to victims' families
item.description:
The Central Bank of Egypt on Thursday directed the Federation of Egyptian Banks to coordinate with lenders to provide EGP60 million in initial support to the families of those killed and injured in the Ring Road accident, following President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi's directives. Governor Hassan Abdalla said the central bank and banking sector would offer further support in coordination with state bodies.
Sources: Amwal Al Ghad English https://en.amwalalghad.com/egypts-c-bank-pledges-egp60-mln-to-ring-road-victims-families/ · Egyptian Gazette https://egyptian-gazette.com/egypt/banks-directed-to-provide-initial-support-of-le60m-to-families-of-ring-road-accident-victims · About Msr https://aboutmsr.com/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D9%86%D9%88%D9%83-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%85-%D8%A3%D8%B3%D8%B1-%D8%B6%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%88%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D8%AD/

item.title: Madbouly approves investment certificates and replacement cars for Warraq victims' families
item.description:
Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly on Thursday ordered exceptional compensation for the families of the Warraq accident victims, including investment certificates paying periodic returns for a stable income and replacement cars for owners of burned vehicles, after visiting the injured at Sheikh Zayed Specialised Hospital. He tasked the Social Solidarity Minister with coordination, saying the families' pain exceeds any financial compensation.
Sources: Alam Al Mal https://alamalmal.net/article/944274/%D9%85%D8%AF%D8%A8%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D9%8F%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%AD%D8%B2%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%B6%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%84%D8%B6%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%AB-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%82 · Youlyou https://www.youlyou.com/103361 · Cairo Mubasher https://www.cairomubasher.com/256754

item.title: Gold rises in evening trade, with 21-carat at EGP5,630
item.description:
Gold prices in Egypt rose about EGP20 in Thursday evening trade compared with midday, with 21-carat at about EGP5,630 a gram, 24-carat at about EGP6,434 and the gold pound at EGP45,040. The rise came after 21-carat traded at about EGP5,615 during the day, even as the global ounce fell 0.46% to about $3,570.
Sources: Masrawy https://masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/26/3085030/%D8%B3%D8%B9%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B0%D9%87%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%85-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%B9-%D8%A8%D8%AD%D9%84%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%A9 · Cairo Mubasher https://www.cairomubasher.com/256754

item.title: El-Sisi, with Qatar's Amir, urges Gaza deal implementation and a Palestinian state
item.description:
President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi, in Thursday's talks with Qatar's Amir, urged all parties to implement the Gaza ceasefire agreement and praised close coordination with Doha, according to presidential spokesman Ambassador Mohamed El-Shennawy. El-Sisi reiterated support for an independent Palestinian state on the 4 June 1967 lines with East Jerusalem as its capital, and called for stronger partnership in trade, investment and energy.
Sources: Daily News Egypt https://dailynewsegypt.com/2026/11/26/egypt-and-qatar-call-for-regional-de-escalation-stronger-economic-and-energy-ties-during-emirs-cairo-visit/ · MENAFN (QNA) https://menafn.com/1112027373/Amir-President-Of-Egypt-Hold-Official-Talks-Session

item.title: Eurozone leaders pick Spain's de Cos to head the European Central Bank
item.description:
Leaders of the 21 eurozone countries on Thursday in Brussels chose Pablo Hernández de Cos, former Bank of Spain governor and general manager of the Bank for International Settlements, to succeed Christine Lagarde, who leaves on 7 February. Markus Brunnermeier and Laurence Boone were named for the Executive Board; de Cos is seen as dovish, with inflation at 4% against a 2% target.
Sources: WSLS (AP) https://www.wsls.com/business/2026/11/26/leaders-choose-spains-former-central-bank-head-as-next-european-central-bank-president/ · UA.News https://ua.news/en/world/u-es-pogodili-kandidaturu-novogo-kerivnika-evropeiskogo-tsentrobanku

item.title: Israel kills Hamas official in Deir Al-Balah as Al-Hayya rejects "equation of killing"
item.description:
An Israeli strike on an apartment in Deir Al-Balah on Thursday killed Khaled Abu Nada, a Hamas political bureau member and deputy education minister in Gaza, and his wife, in strikes that killed at least eight Palestinians. Hamas Gaza chief Khalil Al-Hayya said the equation of killing and blockade was unacceptable under the agreement and that the group would discuss a response with other factions. The Gaza health ministry puts the war toll at 74,746.
Sources: WSLS (AP) https://www.wsls.com/news/world/2026/11/26/israeli-strikes-kill-8-in-gaza-and-other-mideast-news/ · Arab News (Reuters) https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/hamas-weighs-response-after-israel-kills-10-people-in-gaza-3014108

item.title: Kushner links stalled Ukraine talks to an alleged attack on Putin's residence
item.description:
US envoy Jared Kushner said in an interview with Axel Springer chief Mathias Doepfner that Ukraine-Russia peace talks stalled in early 2026 after an alleged Ukrainian attack on Putin's Valdai residence, although US intelligence and President Trump said it did not happen. In the same interview Kushner urged Israel to leave the constant wartime mindset and focus on economic diplomacy.
Sources: Meduza https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/26/kushner-blames-stalled-peace-talks-on-alleged-ukrainian-attack-on-putin-s-residence-an-attack-both-u-s-intelligence-and-trump-say-did-not-happen · The Times of Israel https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog-november-26-2026/

item.title: European shares rise 1.8% as tariff fears ease
item.description:
The STOXX 600 closed 1.8% higher on Thursday at 636.98 points and Germany's DAX rose 2.1% to 25,215.52, with every sector up, led by miners, autos, defence and technology. The rally followed Washington's signal of a lower cap on new tariffs, with EU import duties expected to stay at 15%, while US markets were shut for Thanksgiving.
Sources: JBizNews https://jbiznews.com/european-stocks-jump-as-tariff-fears-ease-stoxx-600-gains-1-8-dax-rises-2-1/ · InstaForex https://www.instaforex.com/forex-news/3305885

item.title: Brent climbs to $95.58 on refinery and mine attacks
item.description:
January Brent rose to $95.58 a barrel at 1:08pm GMT on Thursday, up 1.03%, a third day of gains, after Houthi attacks on Saudi refineries and reports of tankers hitting mines in Hormuz. There was no US crude settlement because of Thanksgiving, and OPEC+ meets on Sunday to set the 2027 output framework.
Sources: FinanceFeeds https://financefeeds.com/brent-crude-oil-price-95-58-thursday-three-day-rally-before-opec-plus-sunday-bull-100-bear-91/ · Yahoo Finance (Reuters) https://finance.yahoo.com/energy/articles/oil-rises-supply-concerns-iran-030849858.html

item.title: Nine dead and 17 missing as flood hits illegal Indonesian gold mine
item.description:
Rescuers in West Java recovered nine bodies from an illegal gold mine about 100 metres deep in Bogor regency, flooded by the Ciseureuh River after heavy rain, while 17 workers remain trapped. Some 325 rescuers took part, and the head of Jakarta's search and rescue agency said the water had yet to recede.
Sources: Xinhua https://english.news.cn/20261126/f4bab18cd9e44db1b2c399a4ab227906/c.html · WDBO (AP) https://www.wdbo.com/news/world/flood-that-hit-an/GXOAVJRALIZD7AZXOXBQWZL3FI/
